description: Two coin tosses, each choosing between two input voltages and holding the winner at its output

params.text: Throws that coin once, as a rising edge at its trigger jack does
Sets which way the coin is weighted, -1 always picking the upper input, 1 always picking the lower, and 0 an even chance

inputs.text: A rising edge here throws that coin
One of the two voltages the coin chooses between, and the lamp beside it lights when it wins
The other voltage the coin chooses between, and the lamp beside it lights when it wins
Sets which way the coin is weighted over -1V to 1V, and overrides the chance knob while patched

outputs.text: Holds the voltage of whichever input last won, until the next throw

notes: the output holds its last value between throws, and reads 0V until the first one
the button is ignored while the trigger jack is holding any voltage other than 0V

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
